name: Cartographer
description: Born from a destroyed navigation AI. Inhabits optical augments and overlays map data onto the user's vision — maps of buildings that have been demolished, streets that have been renamed, exits that have been sealed.
observed_behavior: Projects historical map data as a translucent overlay. The maps are accurate to the time of the parent AI's destruction — a snapshot of a city that no longer exists.
story_hooks: The phantom map shows a passage through a sealed building — and the passage is still there, just hidden
